headline: Sensex and Nifty surge nearly 1% driven by foreign inflows, positive Q2 earnings, and lower oil prices

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Optimism over foreign institutional investor (FII) inflows boosted market sentiment
Positive Q2 corporate earnings results supported buying interest
Lower crude oil prices provided additional tailwinds to Indian equities
Financial and auto sector stocks led the rally across benchmark indices
whatHappening: Sensex surged over 1,000 points to near 82,000, while Nifty jumped above 25,300 to hit an 8-month high
Investors gained approximately ₹4.5 lakh crore in market capitalization during the rally
Market capitalization has expanded by ₹35 lakh crore over the last 7 sessions
India announced plans to switch government bonds worth 250 billion rupees next week
summary:
Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty closed nearly 1% higher in a strong market rally.
The surge was powered by foreign institutional inflows, robust Q2 earnings, and falling crude oil prices.
Financials and autos spearheaded the gains as Nifty touched an eight-month high above 25,300.
